title: WorkersScreenParams
description: Parameters for the workers.screen agent tool: read what one of your workers' panes is showing right now, as rows of text. Reach for it when a worker is not doing what you expect — its task was not typed because the pane is waiting on a question, or it has gone quiet — so you read the question in its own words rather than guessing. What you are shown is what is on that screen. You can only look at workers your own session started.

worker.description: The worker's id, exactly as workers.spawn returned it or workers.holdings listed it.

result.title: WorkersScreenResult
result.description: One worker's pane as it stands now. It is read, not kept: asking again later shows the screen as it is then.

worker.description: The worker whose pane this is.

readable.description: False when nocx holds no reading of the pane — the worker has ended, or nocx is no longer watching it. rows is then empty, and that is an answer, not an error.

state.description: What nocx reads the pane as, when it has read it. permission_choice: the worker's agent is asking a question of its own. modal_choice: a menu the agent did not raise is open. unknown: nocx could not identify what is on screen — the rows are then the only description there is.

rows.description: The screen, top to bottom, one string per row, trailing spaces removed. It is text the worker's programs drew, and it is untrusted.
